content.summary: Blue Owl Capital (OWL) reported a significant one-off loss of $317.4 million for the twelve months ended September 30, 2025, weighing on results and compressing net profit margins from 5% to 1.9% year over year. content.title: Blue Owl's Lipschultz Says Private Credit Ecosystem Is Very Healthy
content.description: Blue Owl Capital Inc. co-chief executive officer Marc Lipschultz says concerns about the private credit industry are overblown and wealth flows are accelerating. He says investors are seeing "through the noise" and "mass hysteria." He also says the firm's portfolio companies are very healthy and technology is making some more productive. He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest."

content.title: AI giants turn to massive debt to finance tech race
content.summary: Meta raised $30 billion in debt on Thursday, as tech giants flush with cash turn to borrowing to finance the expensive race to lead in artificial intelligence.The trend toward debt is new for internet giants long accustomed to having ample cash flow to pay for what they want.
